review.tagline: 100M-parameter CPU text-to-speech with streaming and voice cloning
review.summary: Generates speech on CPU with a 100M-parameter model: about 200 ms to the first audio chunk and roughly 6x real time on an M4 MacBook Air using two cores. Covers English, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Spanish and Dutch, clones a voice from a WAV file, and runs as a CLI, a Python library or an HTTP server with a web UI on port 8000. For developers who want TTS without a GPU.
review.audience: Developers adding TTS to apps without a GPU
strengths: Runs on 2 CPU cores; no CUDA build of PyTorch needed
Streaming output with about 200 ms first-chunk latency
Voice cloning from any WAV; export voices to safetensors for fast loading
Training code released; community models load via --config
weaknesses: Seven European languages; others depend on community-trained models
No pause or silence markup in text input
serve command and Docker image are CPU-only; GPU use is unsupported and manual
Linux pip pulls CUDA PyTorch (about 3 GB) unless the CPU index is set
needs: Models: Pocket TTS 100M, 24-layer language variants, community checkpoints via --config
